verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring transfers or rule-based automations, so the axis applies. The pack documents no such capability. Webhooks and the Card Auth Loop are developer building blocks for building your own background logic, not product-provided automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
